| Status | `413 Payload Too Large` |
| Type | `https://messagecrate.app/docs/developer/reference/errors/payload-too-large` |

The body is over the server's configured cap, whether announced by `Content-Length` or discovered while reading. `PUT /v1/assets/{sha256}` caps at the attachment size limit, which the owner sets in Server Settings and `GET /v1/server` reports as `asset_max_bytes`. Each part of a multipart upload caps at the part size the upload was given when it started. Every other cap is fixed in the server: `POST /v1/session`, `POST /v1/accounts` and `POST /v1/server/claim` at 32 KiB, any other JSON body at 32 MiB, an address book loaded with `POST /v1/contacts` at 8 MiB, and an import batch, or any other body, at 512 MiB. Send less, or, for an attachment, have the owner raise the limit.
